title: betula pendula f. viscosa
intro: Betula pendula f. viscosa, commonly known as the sticky birch, is a variant of the silver birch tree, characterized by its sticky or viscid bark. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Betula pendula f. viscosa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenic acids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as salicin and betulin, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
